entries.accepted: they do not separate: at the one stably estimable degree the logit-lens/random-projection spread is about an order of magnitude, while refitting the chart alone moves it by a factor of two; no representation separates decisively from the matched compression control

The numerical rationale and the statement that no representation separates decisively are withdrawn. The registered success criterion (an effect outside the matched same-family and compression nulls, with a nontrivial held-out effect and a consistent direction across multiple model-by-task units) was not established: the captures cover one unit (GPT-2, IOI), and the compression control is one fixed pair of random site projections reused across captures, not a distribution over projections. The result shows neither that representation effects are absent nor that any representation separates.
entries.cause: rationale not supported by the shipped check and outside the registered comparison rule

entries.title: Figure 2 (left): residual decay read as a signature of transcendence
entries.accepted: on algebraic slices the residual of the best candidate polynomial collapses to machine precision at d*, whereas on transcendental slices it decays smoothly (geometrically) -- the signature of polynomial approximation rather than vanishing; the absence of a collapse corroborates transcendence; the 1e-13 reference line is labelled 'machine precision'
entries.corrected: Figure 2 (left) plots, per degree, the maximum over three sampling spans ([-2,2], [-8,8], [-32,32]) of a finite-sample relative residual of an SVD candidate polynomial fitted separately on each span. The affine and RMSNorm residuals reach roundoff level at their proved onsets, and the plotted softmax maximum decreases over the tested degrees without crossing 1e-13. In the same artifact the unplotted gated-linear slice falls below 1e-13 at degree 7 in the maximum over spans, and softmax falls below it on the narrowest span at degrees 6-7 and on the middle span at degree 7. The decay pattern is therefore not a diagnostic of transcendence in this check; the infinite onsets rest on the transcendence lemma. The dashed line is a reference level of 1e-13, not machine precision (float64 epsilon is about 2.2e-16).
